_comment: Пробы Chatterbox. model: tts (EN, оригинал), mtl (мультиязычный, есть ru), turbo (EN, теги [laugh]/[chuckle]/[sigh]). Параметры: exaggeration (эмоциональность), cfg_weight (темп/следование голосу), temperature.

probes.text: Hi, I'm Emily. I didn't expect anyone to find this place... but I'm glad you did.
Wait. Did you hear that? Something is moving behind the door. Please, don't open it!
We did it! I can't believe we actually did it! Come on, let's see what's inside!
